title: Generic Repository Pattern
prompt:
You are a web developer. Complete the following task.

TASK: Define and export a generic repository pattern. Export `Entity`, `Repository<T extends Entity>`, and `InMemoryRepository<T extends Entity>`. The repository should support `findAll`, `findById`, `create`, `update`, and `delete`. Auto-generate ids in a uuid-style format and set timestamps on create and update.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Use TypeScript generics and utility types
- Export all required interfaces and classes
- Compile under `tsc --strict --noEmit`
- Do not use `any`

IMPORTANT:
- Return ONLY the code. No explanations.
- Output a single complete file.
- Do not use markdown code blocks.
